decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot was launched only in 2023, so its value is still uncertain, and keeping it costs little because it shares an engineering base with the firm's other robots.
The automatic de-shuttering robot is a core module of automated precast lines, and with little evidence yet on its value and low marginal cost to keep, the option should stay open.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in integrated plant solutions and has had too little time on the market to show that its value will not be realized.

The automatic shuttering robot fits the firm's push toward automated precast production, and since uncertainty about it has not yet resolved and its holding cost is low, keeping it is the sensible choice.
